history.summary: A 33-year-old freehold 3BR (Ava Towers, D12) at $1.9M / $1,548 psf — right on the $1,546 URA median with no value cushion. The 8.1% CAGR rests on a thin 20-txn series and the 1993 build plus 1.5km/18-min MRT walk are real drags for a 5-7yr hold.
history.rating_rationale: Priced at the URA median ($1,548 vs $1,546) leaves zero entry discount. The headline 8.1% CAGR is from only 20 transactions — directional at best, likely flattered by sparse sampling. Freehold tenure removes lease-decay risk, but a 1993 building carries ageing/maintenance concerns and the 1.5km (18-min) walk to Novena weakens both rental and resale appeal. $1.9M sits in a reasonable band but the package is fully priced.
red_flags: Priced exactly at URA median — no value cushion
1.5km / 18-min walk to Novena MRT — weak connectivity
catalysts: Freehold tenure in central-fringe D12 (Balestier/Novena belt)
Novena medical hub proximity supports tenant demand
En-bloc potential for an older freehold site over a long horizon
